question:
Which of the following interchanges of signs would make the given equation correct?

13 × 15 ÷ 98 + 7 - 11 = 198
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f22f57d0cf5c493280a0ab6b7dbaea9e3fc5b035c6d410d59c2f476043bd03a8.png] 

By interchanging the two signs : 

We can check options one by one by using BODMAS rule

Given: 13 × 15 ÷ 98 + 7 - 11 = 198

option 1): - and ÷

After interchanging the signs

13 × 15 - 98 +** __7 ÷ 11__** = 198

__**13 × 15**__ - 98 + 0.63 = 198

**195** - 98 **+ 0.63** = 198

195.63 - 98 = 198
